title: RaySteal - Official Resource Pack
description: The official pack for the RaySteal Lifesteal plugin, adding custom textures for the Heart and Revival Totem.
body:
# RaySteal - Official Resource Pack
This is the official resource pack for the **[RaySteal](https://modrinth.com/plugin/raysteal)**.

This pack provides custom textures for the unique items added by the plugin, ensuring your lifesteal experience looks as good as it feels!

---

### ✨ Features
This pack currently re-textures the following items:
* ❤️ **Heart Item:** A magical heart used to increase your maximum health. (Replaces Red Dye)
* 🛡️ **Revival Totem:** A legendary totem used to bring your eliminated friends back to life. (Replaces Totem of Undying)

This pack uses the `CustomModelData` feature of Minecraft, meaning it will **not** replace the default textures for Red Dye or the Totem of Undying. It will only show the custom textures for the specific items from the RaySteal plugin.
